suggested_fix: No fix required. The kirqfd is added to irqfds_list while holding an SRCU read lock (srcu_read_lock before list_add_tail, released only after vfs_poll/irqfd_inject), so a concurrent deassign that removes and frees the entry must wait in synchronize_srcu and cannot cause a use-after-free. Error paths correctly release the eventfd context, file reference and allocation, and duplicate eventfds are rejected under irqfds_lock.
